name: Quick View For WooCommerce
author: Jthemes Studio

sections.description:
Quick View For Woo is a performance-focused plugin designed to improve your WooCommerce store’s shopping experience. It allows customers to view product details in a modal popup, directly from the shop or category pages—without reloading.

Perfect for fast browsing, mobile-friendly, and loaded with customization options.

Presentation

Premium | Demo | Documentation

Key Features

⭐ Enable or disable Quick View globally
⭐ Enable Quick View on mobile devices
⭐ Display Quick View button/icon on Single Product, Shop & Archive Pages
⭐ Choose icon/button position on product images (Top Left, Top Right, etc.)
⭐ Display types: Show icon always or only on hover
⭐ Customize Quick View button label
⭐ Choose to show Short or Full product description in Quick View
⭐ Set custom dimensions for product images in Quick View
⭐ Customize colors for overlay, close icon, button background, and text
⭐ Fully responsive and compatible with all WordPress & WooCommerce themes
⭐ Developer-friendly with clean, extensible code
⭐ User-friendly settings panel with easy customization
⭐ 24×7 support available for the free version too

Pro Features

⭐ Unlock additional Quick View design styles
⭐ Customize Main Text Color, Star Rating Color
⭐ Style Add to Cart button: background, hover, and text colors
⭐ Display additional product details in Quick View including image, name, rating, price, add to cart button, and product meta (categories, tags, SKU)
⭐ Automatically close popup after adding product to cart
⭐ Redirect users directly to checkout after add to cart
⭐ Smooth popup animations for better UX
⭐ Lightweight and optimized for fast performance
⭐ Share products directly from Quick View via Facebook, X (Twitter), Pinterest, Email, and WhatsApp
⭐ Pro styling and layout control for a branded experience
⭐ Clean, developer-friendly code with hooks and filters
⭐ Works seamlessly with all modern WordPress & WooCommerce themes
⭐ Premium customization options for complete styling control
⭐ Responsive and mobile-ready design for all devices
⭐ Priority 24×7 support for Pro users

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/quick-view-for-woo directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Admin Dashboarc > jthemes > Quick View to configure the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, it works with all WooCommerce-compliant themes.

Is the Quick View feature mobile responsive?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive. You can also choose to enable or disable Quick View specifically for mobile devices in the settings panel.

Can I change the Quick View button label?

Absolutely! You can customize the Quick View button text from the General Settings tab.

Will it affect my site speed?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance. It won’t slow down your website.
